title: Trained 31 more engineers in Scrum and lifted my score to 4.47/5
summary: Three weeks after my first Scrum workshop, I used that cohort's feedback, taught 31 more engineers and saw my presenter score rise from 4.12 to 4.47.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: this was a teaching session.
the_call: Treat the first cohort's feedback as the plan for the next class.
what_i_did: Taught the workshop to 31 engineers, with room for discussion and questions.
what_changed: My presenter score rose to 4.47 out of 5, and participants wrote about the engagement and the pace.

quotes.text: The instructor was engaging the participates well. There were good discussions and doubt clearing.
Instructor was knowledgeable. Pace was perfect.
